label: InstructMol-GS (Vicuna-7B + GIN)
blocker: No trained InstructMol checkpoint (neither InstructMol-GS nor InstructMol-G, nor the stage-1 alignment projector) is publicly released. The upstream repo README (HEAD commit 5b2aa484, 2024-12-02, 'Update README.md') states under 'InstructMol Weights': 'TODO: coming soon'. Released-checkpoint INFERENCE is therefore impossible; no numbers are produced. Not fabricated.
mode_required_by_task: released-checkpoint inference (single pass, no seeds) on SageMaker

coverage.note: 0/9 runnable: no checkpoint exists for ANY task. Even if a checkpoint were released, InstructMol's own MoleculeNet eval protocol supports only 3 of our 9 tasks (bace, bbbp, hiv).

recon.architecture_confirmed: 5-layer GIN graph encoder initialized from MoleculeSTM (molecule_model.pth) + mm-projector + Vicuna-7B-v1.3 LLM; LLaVA-style. 'GS' = graph token + SELFIES string appended to the instruction ('--add-selfies'); 'G' = graph only.

released_component_weights.vicuna_7b_v1.3: https://huggingface.co/lmsys/vicuna-7b-v1.3 (open, not gated) - base LLM only, NOT instruction-tuned for molecules
released_component_weights.scibert: https://huggingface.co/allenai/scibert_scivocab_uncased - used only for the molcap Text2Mol metric, not property prediction

NOT_released: stage-2 task LoRA adapters (checkpoints/Graph-LLaVA/MoleculeNet-llava-moleculestm-vicuna-v1-3-7b-finetune_lora) -- the actual InstructMol-G / InstructMol-GS models

unsupported_of_our_9.lipo: same - not covered by InstructMol regression eval

prompt_format.wrapper: LLaVA conv_template 'llava_v1'; graph image token prepended: '<image>\n' + instruction (or DEFAULT_IM_START/END around image token if mm_use_im_start_end).
prompt_format.gs_variant_suffix: InstructMol-GS appends: ' The compound SELFIES sequence is: {selfies_str}' (SELFIES encoded from SMILES via the `selfies` package).
prompt_format.per_molecule_instruction_text: The task-specific instruction string (e.g. the BBBP/BACE/HIV question) lives in raw['instruction'] inside preprocessed .pkl files under a private path (/cto_labs/AIDD/DATA/MoleculeNet). These .pkl files and their preprocessing are NOT in the repo, so the exact instruction wording is itself not reproducible from released material.

eval_protocol_if_checkpoint_existed.scoring: Hard-label only. Model GENERATES free text; convert_label_to_int maps active/yes/true->1, inactive/no/false->0; roc_auc_score computed on 0/1 HARD labels (NOT positive-token probability). i.e. AUC over hard labels, no probability ranking. Generation is do_sample=True temperature=0.2 (stochastic).

paper_reported_numbers_for_reference_onl.note: From arXiv:2311.16208 (InstructMol-GS, scaffold/random split as in paper, NOT our splits; shown only to document what the method claims - NOT usable as our baseline).
paper_reported_numbers_for_reference_onl.caveat: Paper reports classification ROC-AUC for BBBP/BACE/HIV only. These are NOT computed on our test molecules and are NOT entered into the results table.

decision: STOP EARLY per task decision rule: GS checkpoint (and all trained weights) not released, only component weights + training code. Running base Vicuna + MoleculeSTM-init encoder with an untrained random projector and no LoRA would NOT be InstructMol and would yield meaningless output - that would be fabricating a baseline, so it was NOT done. To produce a real InstructMol-GS number one must reproduce the two-stage training (330K-pair alignment pretraining + MoleculeNet LoRA instruction tuning), which is out of scope for released-checkpoint inference.
